column1: Bill of Quantity for Sanitation System Lower Vashlovani - LOT 2A

column2: Description of work

All items related Works shall be included under the unit prices. All rates for saniation pipeworks and appurtenances for the above mentioned village shall be indicated in this sheet. Rates for civil structures and ancillary works to include but not be limited to septic tanks shall be priced in the adjoining worksheets and are linked to the descriptions in the corresponding row of this worksheet.
